fusions.name: Ploughed Furrow
fusions.desc: Drives your horns through the ground, throwing up a narrow furrow of jagged rock 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 28 rock damage to everything in it. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Flying Divots
fusions.desc: Kicks a clod of turf at the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 earth damage, with a 20% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Salt Lick
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hardpan Underfoot
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 8% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
